files.description: Streaming subscribers, one per row (320 rows): subscriber_id (whole number), age (years, from 19 to 87; about 1% empty), tier (basic, plus or premium; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), monthly_fee (two decimals; about 3% empty), joined_year (whole number).

task_text: For each tier (lower case, no surrounding spaces), compute the mean monthly fee and its sample standard deviation (the version that divides by n - 1), both rounded to three decimals; NumPy functions may be used for the statistics. `result` should be a table indexed by tier with the columns mean and std.
intended_computation: Clean tier (3 tiers) and per tier return the mean and the n-1 standard deviation of monthly_fee (missing fees skipped), rounded to 3 decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x passing the NumPy function is mapped to the pandas n-1 version; 3.x calls NumPy, which divides by n

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
